WITH major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.major_id,
        m.department,
        COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM major AS m
    JOIN member AS mem
        ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
),
major_shares AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        department,
        member_count,
        1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_member_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        department,
        member_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS above_department_average
    FROM major_shares
)
SELECT
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    share,
    above_department_average
FROM scored
WHERE above_department_average > 0
ORDER BY above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
